descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Warsaw puts you in the captain's seat over the real Warsaw.

THE REAL WARSAW
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Palace of Culture, Varso Tower, the Warsaw Spire, the Royal Castle and Old Town, the National Stadium, Lazienki, Wilanow, the Temple of Divine Providence and thirteen Vistula bridges. Four airports: Chopin, Modlin, Babice and the Minsk Mazowiecki air base.

A LIVING CITY
Koleje Mazowieckie, the SKM, the Pendolino, the WKD and the trams on their real tracks, cars and buses on the roads, boats on the Vistula, dinghies on the Zegrze lake. At night the Old Town, the Palace and the Stadium light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Vistula, the Royal Castle out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the Chopin city approach, a Vistula run, THROUGH the Siekierkowski bridge's pylons, the Modlin fortress, a fighter scramble, the Old Town after dark and a Warsaw tour.

POLSKI LUB ENGLISH
Menus, missions and the hangar in Polish or English - switch in the settings.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
